NHTSA gives this model 5 stars overall, frontal and side, and 4 for rollover. vPIC confirms this VIN's 2024 Forester AWD identity and 2.5L gasoline engine. FuelEconomy.gov estimates $1,670–$1,827 annually across two configurations; exact MPG and your commute-specific cost were unavailable. Live same-year Forester asking comps span $17,950–$23,100 with a $21,498 median, but differ in trim/mileage and are not sold prices. This car's low price needs investigation. Accident and salvage history remain unverified: require a current history report, title-brand documentation and an independent structural/mechanical inspection; reject any accident or salvage history. The inventory row lacks a direct dealer URL, so confirm seller and availability before traveling or paying a deposit. NHTSA lists two model-year recalls covering coolant-pipe bolts and front driveshafts, plus 31 complaints; require VIN-specific recall-completion verification, since these checks do not prove open status. Open at $17,000 as a negotiation proposal, not a verified market transaction value. Obtain an itemized written buyer's order including tax, registration and every fee, capped at $22,000 total with no unwanted add-ons. Confirm child-seat fit, driver-assistance operation and appropriate winter tires before purchase.
